meals.name: Baked Eggs with Chickpea Tomato Sauce
steps: Dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and finely chop {{qty:garlic=3}} garlic cloves. Drain and rinse {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a 400g tin}} of chickpeas.

Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan with a lid over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt for 1 minute.
Add {{qty:passata=300g}} passata and the chickpeas. Simmer for 6 minutes until thick, crushing some chickpeas into the sauce.
Stir in {{qty:spinach=150g}} spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Make {{qty:eggs=4}} dips, crack an egg into each, swirl the whites slightly into the sauce.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan. Rest 2 minutes, add black pepper, serve from the pan.

meals.name: Crispy Halloumi & Tomato Spaghetti
steps: Pasta: Bring a large pan of well-salted water to the boil and cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti for 9–10 minutes until tender with a slight bite. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain.

Halloumi: Meanwhile, cut {{qty:halloumi|tin=a 225g block}} of halloumi into 1cm cubes and pat dry. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large, deep frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the halloumi for 3–4 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides. Tip onto a plate.
Sauce: Halve or roughly chop {{qty:tomatoes=4}} tomatoes. Add them to the pan for 1–2 minutes until they soften and blister, then tip onto the halloumi plate.

Sauce: Add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil if the pan is dry, then cook {{qty:garlic=3}} grated or finely chopped garlic cloves for 30 seconds. Pour in {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes, stir in {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs and a small pinch of salt (halloumi is salty). Simmer uncovered for 8–10 minutes until thickened.

To serve: Tip the spaghetti into the sauce with a splash of pasta water and toss until coated. Fold through the halloumi, blistered tomatoes and {{qty:fresh basil=10g}} torn fresh basil. Grind over black pepper and serve.

meals.name: Chicken Thigh Fajita Tortillas
steps: Chicken: Cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into thin strips. In a bowl, rub with {{qty:olive oil:2=2 tbsp}} olive oil, {{qty:garlic=2}} crushed garlic cloves, the juice of {{qty:limes:1=1}} {{pl:limes:1|lime|limes=lime}}, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Set aside while the veg cooks (5–10 minutes is enough).

Veg: Cut {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}} into thin wedges and {{qty:bell peppers=2}} bell peppers into thin strips. Halve or roughly chop {{qty:tomatoes=3}} tomatoes. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion for 4–5 minutes until softened and starting to char at the edges, then lift onto a plate.

Veg: Add the peppers to the pan (another splash of oil if dry) and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft with charred edges. Add the tomatoes for 1–2 minutes until they blister and soften. Season with a pinch of salt, then tip onto the onion plate.

Chicken: Return the pan to high heat. Add the marinated chicken in a single layer and cook for 6–8 minutes, turning, until browned and catching at the edges and cooked through with no pink in the middle. Squeeze over the juice of {{qty:limes:0.5=½}} {{pl:limes:0.5|lime|limes=lime}}.

To serve: Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side until pliable and lightly spotted. Mix {{qty:yoghurt=100g}} yoghurt with the juice of the remaining {{qty:limes:0.5=½}} {{pl:limes:0.5|lime|limes=lime}} and a pinch of salt. Return the veg to the pan with the chicken for 30 seconds to reheat. Fill the tortillas with chicken and veg, top with yoghurt and {{qty:fresh coriander=15g}} chopped fresh coriander, and serve.

meals.name: Creamy Spinach & Feta Baked Potatoes
steps: Potatoes: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Halve {{n:2|large baking potato|large baking potatoes=2 large baking potatoes}} (about {{qty:potatoes=600g}}) lengthways. Rub all over with {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt and lay cut-side down on a baking tray. Roast for 30 minutes, until the cut sides are golden and a knife slides into the thickest part with no resistance.

Filling: Meanwhile, finely chop {{qty:spinach=100g}} spinach and thinly slice {{qty:spring onions=3}} spring onions (about {{x:40 g=40g}}). Coarsely grate {{qty:cheddar=75g}} cheddar and finely grate the zest of {{qty:lemons=½}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}}.

Mash: Turn the potato halves over and let them cool for 2 minutes. Scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving a 1cm shell. Mash with {{qty:butter=20g}} butter, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt and black pepper, then stir in the spinach, spring onions, {{qty:yoghurt=60g}} yoghurt, the lemon zest and two-thirds of the cheddar. Pile back into the shells.
Topping: Crumble {{qty:feta=50g}} feta into a small bowl, toss with the remaining cheddar and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes, and scatter over the potatoes.
Bake: Return to the oven for 8–10 minutes, until the cheese is melted, golden and bubbling and the filling is piping hot in the middle. For a darker top, finish under a hot grill for 2 minutes.
To serve: Serve 2 halves each, straight from the tray.

meals.name: Curried Chickpea & Tomato Coconut Soup
steps: Base: Finely chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves and {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} fresh ginger. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft.
Spices: Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin and {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika for 1 minute until fragrant.

Liquids: Pour in {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes, breaking them up, until slightly thickened. Add {{qty:coconut milk|tin=a 400ml tin}} of coconut milk, {{x:200 ml=200ml}} water, {{qty:stock cubes=1}} crumbled {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}} and {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a drained 400g tin}} of chickpeas.
Simmer: Bring to a boil, then simmer for 8–10 minutes until the soup looks creamy and the chickpeas are hot. For a thicker bowl, blend half with a stick blender and stir back in.

To serve: Season with {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes. Ladle into {{n:2|bowl|bowls=2 bowls}} and top with {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander.

meals.name: Chicken & chickpea curry
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice. Cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed, then leave covered off the heat.

Curry: Meanwhile, thinly slice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and chop {{qty:garlic=3}} garlic cloves. Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 8–10 minutes until soft and golden at the edges.

Curry: Stir in the garlic and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes for 1 minute until fragrant. Add {{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=30g}}) and cook for 1 minute until it darkens slightly.

Curry: Cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into bite-sized chunks. Push the onion mix aside, add the chicken, and cook over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until lightly browned on the outside (it will finish in the sauce).

Curry: Stir in {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper with {{x:150 ml=150ml}} just-boiled water. Cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through (no pink in the middle) and the sauce has thickened.
Curry: Stir in {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a drained 400g tin}} of chickpeas and simmer for 3–4 minutes until hot. Taste for salt.
To serve: Fluff the rice, divide between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=2 bowls}}, spoon over the curry, and finish with {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander.

meals.name: Salmon traybake
steps: Potatoes: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut {{qty:potatoes=400g}} small potatoes into 2cm chunks, toss in a large roasting tray with {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper, and spread out in one layer. Roast for 15 minutes until starting to turn golden.

Onions: Turn the potatoes. Add {{qty:garlic=1}} sliced garlic {{pl:garlic|clove|cloves=clove}} and {{qty:spring onions=3}} spring onions (about {{x:40 g=40g}}) cut into 3cm lengths, and roast for 5 minutes more.

Salmon: Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}) into small florets and {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes into wedges. Add to the tray and stir to coat in the hot oil. Make {{n:2|gap|gaps=two gaps}} and nestle in {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} salmon fillets. Season the salmon with a pinch of salt and drizzle with {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} olive oil.
Roast: Roast for 12–15 minutes, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily in the thickest part, the broccoli is tender with charred tips and the potatoes are golden and crisp at the edges.
Dressing: Meanwhile, mix the zest and juice of {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}} with {{qty:olive oil:1.5=1½ tbsp}} olive oil and a pinch of salt and black pepper.
To serve: Spoon the dressing over the salmon and vegetables and serve from the tray with the other {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}} in wedges.

meals.name: Beef ragù spaghetti
steps: Finely dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and chop {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook them for 3 minutes until soft.
Turn the heat to high, add {{qty:minced beef=400g}} minced beef and cook for 6 minutes, breaking it up and letting it sit between stirs, until properly browned with crusty bits on the pan.
Add {{x:100 ml=100ml}} water and scrape the bottom of the pan for 1 minute (this replaces the deglazing step in the original).

Stir in {{qty:passata=400g}} passata, {{qty:stock cubes=1}} crumbled {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}}, {{qty:soy sauce=1 tsp}} soy sauce, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper.
Simmer on low, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and glossy. If it tastes sharp, give it 5 more minutes — the acidity softens as it reduces.
Cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti in salted boiling water for 9–10 minutes. Keep a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the spaghetti through the ragù with a splash of pasta water so the sauce clings, and serve with {{qty:parmesan=30g}} grated parmesan and black pepper.

meals.name: Halloumi fajitas
steps: Halloumi: Slice {{qty:halloumi|tin=a 225g block}} of halloumi into strips about 1cm thick and pat dry. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and fry the halloumi for 2–3 minutes per side until deep golden. Lift onto a plate.

Veg: Turn the heat to high. Add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil, then {{qty:red onions=1}} sliced {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}} and {{qty:bell peppers=2}} sliced bell peppers. Cook for 5–6 minutes until soft and starting to char. Add {{qty:garlic=2}} crushed garlic cloves, {{taste:2 tsp=2 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes and a pinch of salt for 1 minute until fragrant.
Veg: Return the halloumi, pour over the juice of {{qty:limes:0.5=½}} {{pl:limes:0.5|lime|limes=lime}}, and toss very gently so the cheese does not break up. Grind over black pepper.

To serve: Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Mix {{qty:yoghurt=80g}} yoghurt with the juice of the remaining {{qty:limes:0.5=½}} {{pl:limes:0.5|lime|limes=lime}}. Fill the tortillas with halloumi and peppers, top with yoghurt and {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} fresh coriander.

meals.name: Shakshuka
steps: Dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and {{qty:bell peppers=2}} bell peppers into 1cm pieces and finely chop {{qty:garlic=4}} garlic cloves.

Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan with a lid over medium heat. Add the onion, peppers, garlic, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes and {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring, until the peppers are soft.
Pour in {{qty:passata=400g}} passata and simmer for 8–10 minutes until thick enough that a spoon leaves a trail. Taste for salt.
Make {{qty:eggs=4}} dips in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Swirl the whites a little into the sauce with a fork without breaking the yolks.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Meanwhile warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Take off the heat, rest for 2 minutes, crumble {{qty:feta=80g}} feta over with black pepper, and serve from the pan with the tortillas.

meals.name: Chickpea & spinach curry
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.

Curry: Meanwhile, chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat, add {{qty:curry paste=2 tbsp}} curry paste and cook for 1 minute until it starts to split and smell fragrant, then add the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until soft.
Curry: Tip in {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes and bubble for 5–6 minutes, stirring, until the sauce has reduced and a spoon leaves a brief trail.
Curry: Add {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a drained 400g tin}} of chickpeas, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Cook for 2 minutes until the chickpeas are hot through.

To serve: Take off the heat, tip in {{qty:spinach=200g}} spinach and let the residual heat wilt the leaves for 1–2 minutes. Squeeze over the juice of {{qty:lemons=½}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}}, fluff the rice, and serve the curry over it.

meals.name: Greek chicken bowls
steps: Marinade: Mix {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} cumin, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} paprika, the zest and juice of {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}}, {{qty:garlic:1=1}} crushed garlic {{pl:garlic:1|clove|cloves=clove}}, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper. Coat {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs and leave for 15 minutes (or chill up to 48 hrs — Cassie Best).
Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then rest covered.

Tzatziki: Halve {{qty:cucumber=½}} {{pl:cucumber|cucumber|cucumbers=cucumber}} (about {{x:150 g=150g}}) lengthways, scoop out the seeds and finely chop. Mix with {{qty:yoghurt=150g}} yoghurt, {{qty:garlic:0.5=½}} crushed garlic {{pl:garlic:0.5|clove|cloves=clove}}, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Chill.

Chicken: Heat the grill to its highest setting. Lay the thighs flat on a foil-lined tray and grill for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway and basting with the tray juices, until charred at the edges and cooked through with no pink in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Salad: Chop {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes (seeds removed) and thinly slice {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}}. Toss with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.

To serve: Divide the rice between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=two bowls}}. Top with the sliced chicken, tomato–red onion salad and a big spoon of tzatziki. Serve with the remaining {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}} in wedges.

meals.name: Veggie spaghetti pomodoro
steps: Sauce: Finely dice {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}}. Heat {{qty:olive oil=3 tbsp}} olive oil in a wide, deep pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft but not brown. Stir in {{qty:garlic=2}} crushed garlic cloves and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes; cook 1 minute.

Sauce: Tip in {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes, {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=15g}}) and most of {{qty:fresh basil=15g}} fresh basil (keep a few leaves to finish). Season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper. Simmer gently for 15–18 minutes until thick and saucy (odd bubble on the surface — Cloake).

Pasta: Meanwhile, cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti in a large pan of well-salted boiling water for about 6 minutes until bendy but still chalky in the middle. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, drain.
Finish: Tip the pasta into the sauce and cook together for 4–6 minutes, tossing, until the spaghetti is done and the sauce clings. Loosen with pasta water if it looks tight.
To serve: Divide between bowls. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, the remaining basil leaves and black pepper. No cheese.

meals.name: Lemon garlic roast chicken & potatoes
steps: Oven: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Scrub {{qty:potatoes=400g}} new or salad potatoes and cut into slices about 1cm thick.

Chicken: Pat {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs dry and season with {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt. Heat {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} of the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken skin-side down for 5–6 minutes, without moving, until the skin is deep golden. Turn and cook for 1 minute on the underside.

Dressing: In a bowl, mix the juice of {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}}, {{qty:garlic=3}} finely chopped garlic cloves, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs and the remaining {{qty:olive oil:1.5=1½ tbsp}} olive oil.

Tray: Spread the potato slices in a single layer in a roasting tin. Pour over two-thirds of the dressing, season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper, and toss to coat. Sit the chicken on top, skin-side up, and spoon the rest of the dressing over the meat (not the skin, so it stays crisp).
Roast: Roast for 20 minutes.

Broccoli: Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}) into florets. Tuck them between the chicken pieces and turn in the tray juices. Roast for 15 minutes more, until the skin is crisp and golden, the juices run clear with no pink at the bone, the potatoes are tender when pierced and the broccoli is charred at the tips.
To serve: Rest for 3 minutes, then spoon the lemony pan juices over the chicken and potatoes.

meals.name: Beef keema with rice
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice until the water runs clearer. Put it in a small saucepan with {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil, cover, and simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender. Take off the heat and leave covered to steam.

Keema: Meanwhile, finely chop {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}}, grate or crush {{qty:garlic=3}} garlic cloves, and finely grate {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} fresh ginger (about {{x:2 tsp=2 tsp}}). Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6–7 minutes, stirring often, until soft and starting to brown at the edges.

Keema: Stir in the garlic, ginger and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and the raw smell has gone. Add {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin and {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala and stir for 30–60 seconds until the spices smell toasty, not burnt.

Keema: Turn the heat up to medium-high, add {{qty:yoghurt=75g}} yoghurt and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until it looks split and oily rather than creamy (Cloake's cue — that is when the sauce will stay velvety).

Keema: Add {{qty:minced beef=400g}} minced beef and {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt. Break the mince up with a spoon and cook for 5–6 minutes until no pink remains and it starts to release its juices. Grind over {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper.

Keema: Turn the heat to medium-low and simmer gently for 10–12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the liquid has mostly cooked down and you see a rim of orange-tinted oil around the mince (Cloake's doneness cue). If it catches, splash in {{x:1 tbsp=1}}–{{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} water.

To serve: Chop {{qty:fresh coriander=15g}} fresh coriander and stir most of it through the keema. Fluff the rice, divide between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=2 bowls}}, spoon the keema over, and finish with the remaining coriander and a squeeze of juice from {{qty:limes=1}} {{pl:limes|lime|limes=lime}}. Add a spoon of yoghurt on the side if you like.

meals.name: Salmon & broccoli pasta
steps: Pasta: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti until just tender (about 9–10 minutes). Three minutes before the end, add {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}), cut into florets, to the same water. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain the pasta and broccoli together.

Sauce: Meanwhile, slice {{qty:spring onions=4}} spring onions (about {{x:50 g=50g}}). Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a medium non-stick frying pan over medium heat and cook the spring onions with {{qty:garlic=1}} crushed garlic {{pl:garlic|clove|cloves=clove}} for 1–2 minutes until softened.

Salmon: Cut {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} skinless salmon fillets into roughly 3cm chunks. Add to the pan with {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes and cook for about 1 minute, turning. Stir in {{qty:yoghurt=80g}} yoghurt and about {{x:100 ml=100ml}} pasta water. Season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper.
Salmon: Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 3–4 minutes, turning occasionally, until the salmon is opaque and just flakes (add a splash more water if the sauce tightens).

To serve: Tip the spaghetti and broccoli into the pan. Add the zest of {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} and a squeeze of juice, plus {{qty:parmesan=20g}} grated parmesan. Toss gently and serve.

meals.name: Spanish tortilla with tomato salad
steps: Peel {{qty:potatoes=400g}} potatoes (waxy ones hold together best) and slice 3mm thick; pat dry. Finely slice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}.

Heat {{qty:olive oil:4=4 tbsp}} olive oil in a 20cm non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the potatoes and onion with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and cook gently for 15 minutes, turning only a couple of times, until tender but not browned.
Beat {{qty:eggs=5}} eggs with a pinch of salt and black pepper in a large bowl. Tip the potatoes and onion into the eggs (leave the oil in the pan) and mix.
Pour the mixture back into the pan over low heat and cook for 8 minutes until the edges are set and the centre still wobbles.
Put a plate over the pan, flip the tortilla onto it, slide it back in and cook for 3 minutes more.
Meanwhile dice {{qty:tomatoes=3}} tomatoes and dress with {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil, a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Rest the tortilla for 2 minutes, cut into wedges and serve warm with the tomato salad.

meals.name: Halloumi & chickpea traybake
steps: Veg: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut {{qty:bell peppers=2}} bell peppers into thick strips and {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}} into wedges. Toss in a roasting tin with {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil and black pepper, spread out in one layer and roast for 15 minutes until softening and catching at the edges.

Chickpeas: Drain {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a 400g tin}} of chickpeas and quarter {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes. Tip both into the tin with {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, the zest of {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} and half its juice. Toss to combine.

Halloumi: Pat {{qty:halloumi|tin=a 225g block}} of halloumi dry. Cut deep slits about halfway down into the top in a criss-cross pattern. Nestle it in the middle of the tin and drizzle with {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} olive oil.
Roast: Roast for 15–20 minutes, until the halloumi is golden on top and soft inside, the tomatoes have collapsed and the peppers are tender.
To serve: Squeeze over the remaining lemon juice. Break the halloumi into pieces at the table and serve with {{qty:yoghurt=80g}} yoghurt spooned over.

meals.name: Chicken tikka-style wraps
steps: Marinade: From {{qty:yoghurt|ref=150g}} yoghurt, mix {{qty:yoghurt:100=100g}} with {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil, {{qty:garlic=2}} grated garlic cloves, {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} grated fresh ginger, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, the juice of {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}}, {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper.
Chicken: Cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into 2–3cm pieces, pierce with a fork, and coat in the marinade. Rest 10 minutes (or up to overnight in the fridge).

Grill: Heat the grill to medium-high. Spread the chicken on a foil-lined tray, shake off excess marinade, and grill for 8–10 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through with no pink. Brush with {{qty:butter=10g}} melted butter for the last minute.

Salad: Meanwhile, thinly slice {{qty:onions=½}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and dice {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes. Toss with the juice of the remaining {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}}, a pinch of salt and {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander.

To serve: Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds each side. Fill with chicken, the onion–tomato salad, and a spoon of the remaining {{qty:yoghurt:50=50g}} yoghurt. Fold and serve.

meals.name: Egg fried rice with broccoli
steps: Rice: If you have no cold leftover rice, rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} long-grain or jasmine rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then spread on a plate to steam off for 10 minutes until no longer steaming (fridge-cold overnight is better — Cloake). You need about {{x:400 g=400}}–{{x:450 g=450g}} cooked rice.

Wok: Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}) into small florets. Finely slice {{qty:spring onions=4}} spring onions (about {{x:50 g=50g}}). Beat {{qty:eggs=3}} eggs with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt.

Wok: Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the broccoli with {{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} water for 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp and the water has gone. Tip onto a plate.
Wok: Return the pan to high heat until almost smoking. Add {{qty:olive oil:2=2 tbsp}} olive oil, then the cold rice. Spread it out, then toss until every grain is coated and hot, 1–2 minutes.

Wok: Pour in the beaten eggs and stir furiously so most of the egg is absorbed into the rice (Ken Hom / Cloake). Keep stir-frying for 2–3 minutes until some grains begin to toast and caramelise at the edges. Return the broccoli and toss through.
To serve: Throw over the spring onions, grind black pepper, and serve immediately.

meals.name: Beef & bell pepper tacos
steps: Pickle: Finely slice {{qty:red onions:0.5=½}} {{pl:red onions:0.5|red onion|red onions=red onion}} and toss with the juice of {{qty:limes:1=1}} {{pl:limes:1|lime|limes=lime}} and a pinch of salt. Set aside to soften while you cook.

Beef: Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Crumble in {{qty:minced beef=400g}} minced beef and cook for 12–15 minutes, stirring only now and then, until the liquid evaporates and the mince is deeply browned and crisp in places (Barney's cue).

Beef: Stir in {{qty:garlic=2}} crushed garlic cloves, {{taste:2 tsp=2 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:2 tsp=2 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in {{x:150 ml=150ml}} water with {{qty:stock cubes=1}} crumbled {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}}, simmer 5–6 minutes until thick and glossy.

Peppers: Meanwhile, in a second pan (or push the beef aside), cook {{qty:bell peppers=2}} sliced bell peppers and the remaining {{qty:red onions:0.5=½}} {{pl:red onions:0.5|red onion|red onions=red onion}} in a splash of oil over high heat for 5–6 minutes until soft and charred at the edges. Stir into the beef.

To serve: Dice {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes. Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan until blistered. Fill with the beef and peppers, top with pickled onion, tomato, a spoon of yoghurt ({{qty:yoghurt=80g}} total) and {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander. Serve with the remaining {{qty:limes:1=1}} {{pl:limes:1|lime|limes=lime}} in wedges.

meals.name: Coconut salmon curry
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.

Salmon: Season {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} salmon fillets with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Sear the salmon flesh-side down for 1½ minutes until golden, flip for 1 minute, then lift onto a plate (still raw inside).

Sauce: Turn the heat to medium. Add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil, {{qty:garlic=2}} grated garlic cloves and {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} grated fresh ginger. Cook for 1 minute until the garlic is light golden. Stir in {{qty:curry paste=1 tbsp}} curry paste and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes for 30 seconds.
Sauce: Pour in {{qty:coconut milk|tin=a 400ml tin}} of coconut milk, scraping the pan. Stir in {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} soy sauce and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Salmon: Nestle the salmon back into the sauce. Simmer gently for 4–5 minutes until it flakes and is only just opaque in the middle. Lift the salmon onto the rice bowls.

To serve: Stir {{qty:spinach=150g}} spinach into the sauce until wilted (1 minute). Add the zest and juice of {{qty:limes=1}} {{pl:limes|lime|limes=lime}} to taste. Spoon the sauce and spinach over the salmon, and finish with {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander.

meals.name: Baked feta pasta
steps: Oven: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put {{qty:feta|tin=a 200g block}} of feta in the middle of a medium baking dish. Scatter {{qty:tomatoes=5}} tomatoes (about {{x:400 g=400g}}; cherry whole, or larger ones halved) and {{qty:garlic=2}} unpeeled garlic cloves around it. Drizzle with {{qty:olive oil=3 tbsp}} olive oil, grind over black pepper and a small pinch of salt (feta is salty).
Oven: Bake for 25–30 minutes until the tomatoes are bursting and blistered and the feta is soft and golden at the edges.
Pasta: Meanwhile, bring a large pan of well-salted water to the boil and cook {{qty:penne=180g}} penne for 10–11 minutes until tender with a slight bite. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Sauce: Take the dish out. Squeeze the garlic from its skins into the tomatoes. With a fork, mash the soft feta into the burst tomatoes until you have a creamy, rustic sauce.

To serve: Tip the penne into the dish with a splash of pasta water and toss until every piece is coated (add more water if it looks tight). Tear over {{qty:fresh basil=15g}} fresh basil, grind black pepper, and serve straight from the dish.

meals.name: Chicken & broccoli rice bowls
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then rest covered off the heat.

Broccoli: Put the kettle on. Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}) into florets (halved if large) and tip into a pan, cover with boiling water and boil for 4 minutes until just tender. Drain, keeping {{x:4 tbsp=4 tbsp}} of the water.

Wok: Cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. Shred {{qty:fresh ginger=15g}} fresh ginger and {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves, slice {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}} and cut {{qty:bell peppers=1}} {{pl:bell peppers|bell pepper|bell peppers=bell pepper}} into strips. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1½ tbsp}} olive oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the ginger, garlic, onion and pepper for 2–3 minutes. Stir in {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} paprika and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes.
Wok: Add the chicken and stir-fry for 6–7 minutes until golden and cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Sauce: Tip in the broccoli with {{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} soy sauce and the reserved broccoli water. Toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Grind over black pepper.
To serve: Fluff the rice, divide between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=two bowls}} and spoon the chicken, broccoli and pan juices on top.

meals.name: Spiced potato & spinach curry
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.
Aloo: Cut {{qty:potatoes=500g}} potatoes into 2cm chunks. Finely chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves and {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} fresh ginger.

Aloo: Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large lidded pan over medium heat. Cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 3–4 minutes until soft. Stir in the potatoes, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} paprika, {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=15g}}) and {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt for 2 minutes until the puree coats the potatoes.
Aloo: Add {{x:100 ml=100ml}} water, cover, and cook for 12–15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife (add a splash more water if they catch).
Saag: Tip in {{qty:spinach=200g}} spinach, cover for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then stir through. Grind over black pepper.
To serve: Fluff the rice and spoon the potato and spinach curry alongside.

meals.name: Beef meatballs in tomato sauce
steps: Meatballs: Finely chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} (pieces about 3mm) and {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves, keeping the garlic separate. Put half the onion in a bowl with {{qty:minced beef=400g}} minced beef, {{qty:eggs=1}} {{pl:eggs|egg|eggs=egg}}, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper, and mix with your hands for 1 minute until evenly combined and slightly sticky.

Meatballs: Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and fry {{per:test patty=1 tsp}} of the mix for 1 minute until browned and cooked through. Let it cool for a moment, taste it, add more salt or pepper to the bowl if it is bland, and take the pan off the heat. With wet hands, roll the mix into {{n:16|ball|balls=16 balls}} the size of a chocolate truffle (about {{per:each ball=30g}}, 3–4cm across), until smooth with no cracks.

Sauce: Put a large pan of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the rest of the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft and translucent, then add the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.

Sauce: Add {{qty:passata=400g}} passata and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt and simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until slightly thickened and a spoon drawn through leaves a brief trail.

Meatballs: Meanwhile, while the sauce simmers, add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil to the frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the meatballs in one layer for 5 minutes, turning, until deeply browned all over (two batches if the pan is smaller than 28cm), then turn the heat to medium-low and fry for 5 more minutes until cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Pasta: Meanwhile, once the water is boiling, cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti for 9–10 minutes until tender with a slight bite. Scoop out a mug of the pasta water, then drain.

To serve: Toss the spaghetti through the sauce with a splash of pasta water for 1 minute until glossy and coated. Divide between {{n:2|plate|plates=2 plates}}, top with the meatballs, and finish with {{qty:parmesan=30g}} grated parmesan and black pepper.

meals.name: Chickpea shakshuka
steps: Dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and {{qty:bell peppers=1}} {{pl:bell peppers|bell pepper|bell peppers=bell pepper}} into 1cm pieces and finely chop {{qty:garlic=3}} garlic cloves. Drain and rinse {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a 400g tin}} of chickpeas.

Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan with a lid over medium heat. Add the onion, pepper, garlic, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt. Cook for 7 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Add {{qty:passata=300g}} passata and the chickpeas. Simmer for 8 minutes until thick enough that a spoon leaves a trail; crush a few chickpeas against the pan to thicken it. Taste for salt.
Make {{qty:eggs=4}} dips in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Swirl the whites slightly into the sauce with a fork, leaving the yolks whole.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Meanwhile warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Rest off the heat for 2 minutes, grind over black pepper, and serve from the pan with the tortillas.

meals.name: One-pot lemon chicken & rice
steps: Marinade: Zest {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} and squeeze {{x:3 tbsp=3 tbsp}} juice. Toss {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs with half the zest, {{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} of the juice, {{qty:garlic:2=2}} crushed garlic cloves, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper. Leave 10 minutes while you prep (longer is better — Nagi).

Chicken: Heat {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} olive oil in a deep lidded frying pan over medium-high heat. Lift the chicken from the marinade (keep the marinade) and sear for 2–3 minutes per side until golden but not cooked through. Set aside and wipe out any burnt bits.

Rice: Add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil and {{qty:onions=1}} finely diced {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}; cook for 3–4 minutes until translucent. Add {{qty:garlic:1=1}} more crushed garlic {{pl:garlic:1|clove|cloves=clove}}, {{qty:rice=150g}} rinsed rice, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt, the reserved marinade, the remaining {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} lemon juice and {{x:375 ml=375ml}} hot water with {{qty:stock cubes=1}} {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}} crumbled in. Bring to a simmer for 30 seconds.
One pot: Sit the chicken on top, cover and cook on medium-low for 15–18 minutes until the liquid is absorbed, the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Rest: Take off the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve: Scatter the remaining lemon zest over the rice, grind over black pepper and serve straight from the pan.

meals.name: Crispy salmon & smashed potatoes
steps: Potatoes: Halve any of the {{qty:potatoes=500g}} baby potatoes bigger than a golf ball. Boil in well-salted water for 12–15 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).

Smash: Drain and leave in the colander to steam-dry for 3 minutes. Tip onto a lined baking tray, spaced apart, and squash each one with a fork or masher so it flattens but holds together. Leave to steam-dry for 2 minutes more.
Bake: Melt {{qty:butter=20g}} butter and drizzle over the potatoes, then {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper. Bake for 12 minutes without turning.

Broccoli: Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}) into florets and add to the gaps on the tray with a pinch of salt. Bake for 10 minutes more, until the potatoes are deep golden and crisp on the edges and the broccoli is charred at the tips.

Yoghurt: Mix {{qty:yoghurt=80g}} yoghurt with the juice of {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}} and a pinch of salt. Cut the other {{qty:lemons:0.5=½}} {{pl:lemons:0.5|lemon|lemons=lemon}} into wedges.

Salmon: While the broccoli roasts, pat {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} skin-on salmon fillets very dry. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper just before cooking. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1.5=1½ tbsp}} olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Lay the salmon in skin-side down, turn the heat to medium and press each fillet flat for 10 seconds.

Salmon: Cook for 6–7 minutes without moving, until the colour has turned opaque three-quarters of the way up the side and the skin is crisp. Flip for 90 seconds, then flip back skin-side down over medium-high heat for a final 60 seconds.
To serve: Spoon the lemon yoghurt onto the plates, sit the salmon on top skin-side up, and add the smashed potatoes, broccoli and lemon wedges.

meals.name: Beef stuffed peppers
steps: Peppers: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Halve {{qty:bell peppers=2}} bell peppers lengthways and scoop out the seeds and white membrane. Put them cut-side up in a roasting tin, rub with {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt, and roast for 20 minutes until softened.

Mince: Meanwhile, finely chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and {{qty:minced beef=300g}} minced beef, turn the heat up to high and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.

Sauce: Stir in {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{qty:stock cubes=½}} crumbled {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}}, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Simmer uncovered for 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick enough to hold its shape on a spoon.

Stuff & bake: Divide the mince between the pepper halves, pressing it in, and scatter over {{qty:parmesan=30g}} grated parmesan. Return to the oven for 10 minutes until the cheese is golden and the pepper edges are tender.
To serve: Rest for 2 minutes and serve 2 halves each, with the juices from the tin spooned over.

meals.name: Chicken saag-style curry
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.

Saag: Meanwhile, finely chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves and {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} fresh ginger. Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, add the onion, garlic and ginger, cover and cook for 5 minutes until soft and starting to brown.
Saag: Stir in {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:2 tsp=2 tsp}} garam masala and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} paprika for 1 minute until fragrant.

Saag: Cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces, season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper, and stir-fry in the spices for 4–5 minutes until lightly browned outside.

Saag: Add {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes (roughly chopped), {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=15g}}) and {{qty:spinach=200g}} spinach (in handfuls). Cook, stirring, for 5–6 minutes until the spinach has wilted and the tomatoes have broken down into a sauce. The chicken should be cooked through with no pink.
To serve: Take off the heat and stir in {{qty:yoghurt=50g}} yoghurt until creamy (do not boil). Fluff the rice, divide between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=2 bowls}} and spoon the saag over.

meals.name: Greek-style chickpea salad bowls
steps: Dressing: In a large bowl, mix the juice of {{qty:lemons=½}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} with {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil, the mixed herbs, salt and black pepper.

Salad: Finely chop {{qty:red onions=1}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}}, cut {{qty:cucumber=½}} {{pl:cucumber|cucumber|cucumbers=cucumber}} into chunks and {{qty:tomatoes=3}} tomatoes into wedges. Drain and rinse {{qty:chickpeas=400g}} chickpeas. Pile everything into the bowl but don't toss yet.

Feta: Cut {{qty:feta=200g}} feta into 2cm cubes, pat dry and toss with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} cumin. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the cubes for 1–2 minutes, turning them, until golden on the outside and just starting to soften.
To serve: Toss the salad. Divide {{qty:spinach=100g}} spinach between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=2 bowls}}, pile the salad on top and scatter over the warm feta.

meals.name: Spinach & feta omelette with potatoes
steps: Dice {{qty:potatoes=400g}} potatoes into 1cm cubes. Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the potatoes for 12 minutes, turning, until golden and tender. Season with salt and keep warm on a plate.
In the same pan, wilt {{qty:spinach=150g}} spinach for 1 minute, squeeze out the water, and divide into {{n:2|pile|piles=two piles}}. Crumble {{qty:feta=100g}} feta.
Beat {{per:omelette=3}} eggs (of {{qty:eggs=6}} in total) with a pinch of salt and black pepper — beat each omelette's eggs separately.

Wipe the pan, set it over medium heat and melt {{per:omelette=15g}} butter ({{qty:butter=30g}} for the {{n:2|omelette|omelettes=two omelettes}}). Pour in the eggs, stir briefly for 10 seconds, then leave them to spread over the base.
As the edges set, lift them with a spatula and tilt the pan so the raw egg runs underneath; repeat 2–3 times, about 2 minutes.

Scatter one pile of spinach and an equal share of the feta over one half, cover with a lid for 30 seconds until the top is just set, fold the other half over and slide onto a plate with an equal share of the potatoes.
Repeat steps 3–6 for the second omelette{{at46: and each remaining one=}} and serve straight away.

meals.name: Baked tomato & basil risotto
steps: Oven: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the kettle and dissolve {{qty:stock cubes=1}} vegetable {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}} in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} hot water.

Base: Melt {{qty:butter=15g}} butter in a medium ovenproof pan with a lid over medium heat. Fry {{qty:onions=1}} chopped {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} for 3–4 minutes until starting to soften, then add {{qty:garlic=2}} crushed garlic cloves for 1 minute, stirring. Tip in {{qty:arborio rice=150g}} arborio rice and stir to coat in the butter.
Base: Add {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes and the hot stock, season with salt and black pepper and stir well.
Bake: Cover tightly and bake for 20 minutes. Carefully take out (hot handle) and stir — the rice should be just cooked with a little bite and the risotto still quite loose.
Rest: Tear in most of {{qty:fresh basil=15g}} fresh basil, stir, put the lid back on and leave to stand for 3–4 minutes to thicken.
To serve: Spoon into bowls, drizzle each with olive oil ({{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} in total) and scatter the rest of the basil and a grind of black pepper.

meals.name: Beef & potato curry
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.

Beef: Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large saucepan over high heat. Add {{qty:minced beef=400g}} minced beef with {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} salt and cook for 5–6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Tip into a bowl and discard excess fat.

Base: Lower to medium. Add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil and cook {{qty:onions=1}} finely chopped {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, {{qty:garlic=2}} chopped garlic cloves and {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} chopped fresh ginger for 6–8 minutes until soft.

Curry: Stir in {{qty:curry paste=2 tbsp}} curry paste, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes and {{qty:potatoes=400g}} potatoes cut into 2cm chunks. Cook for 2 minutes. Add {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=15g}}), {{qty:stock cubes=1}} crumbled {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}}, {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water and the beef. Season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper.
Simmer: Bring to a simmer, cover partly, and cook for 18–20 minutes until the potatoes are tender when pierced and the sauce has thickened. Stir now and then; splash in water if it catches.
To serve: Fluff the rice, spoon the curry over, and finish with {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander and a spoon of yoghurt ({{qty:yoghurt=50g}}).

meals.name: Chicken fajita rice
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in a pan of boiling salted water for 10–12 minutes until just tender. Drain well and spread on a tray to steam off and cool while you cook the rest.

Chicken: Cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into bite-sized chunks and season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large wok or high-sided frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 6–8 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through with no pink in the middle. Lift onto a plate.

Veg: Roughly chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and {{qty:bell peppers=2}} bell peppers. Add {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil to the pan with a pinch of salt and cook for 5–6 minutes until just tender and starting to colour at the edges.
Spice: Stir in {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} mixed herbs; fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Rice: Tip in the rice, return the chicken and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until everything is piping hot.
To serve: Squeeze over the juice of {{qty:limes=1}} {{pl:limes|lime|limes=lime}}, scatter {{qty:fresh coriander=15g}} chopped fresh coriander, toss and serve.

meals.name: Salmon tacos with lemon yoghurt
steps: Oven: Preheat the grill to high, or the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line a tray with foil and brush with {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil.

Salmon: Mix {{taste:2 tsp=2 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{qty:garlic=1}} crushed garlic {{pl:garlic|clove|cloves=clove}}, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Rub over {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} salmon fillets. Grill or roast for 8–10 minutes until the flesh flakes and is only just opaque in the middle.
Yoghurt: Meanwhile, mix {{qty:yoghurt=150g}} yoghurt with the zest and juice of {{qty:limes:1=1}} {{pl:limes:1|lime|limes=lime}}, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes and a pinch of salt.
Tortillas: Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side until pliable and lightly spotted.

To serve: Flake the salmon into chunks, discarding the skin. Spread each tortilla with lime yoghurt, add a small handful of spinach ({{qty:spinach=80g}} total), the salmon and {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander. Serve with the remaining {{qty:limes:1=1}} {{pl:limes:1|lime|limes=lime}} cut into wedges.

meals.name: Spaghetti aglio e olio with spinach
steps: Pasta: Bring a large pan of well-salted water to the boil and cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti for about 9–10 minutes until al dente (keep a mug of pasta water).

Oil: When the pasta is nearly ready, heat {{qty:olive oil=4 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add {{qty:garlic=4}} thinly sliced garlic cloves and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes; sizzle for about 1 minute until the garlic is fragrant and lightly golden — not brown (bitter if dark).
Spinach: Add {{qty:spinach=150g}} spinach in handfuls and stir until wilted, 1–2 minutes.
Toss: Drain the spaghetti and tip it into the pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss for 1 minute until the oil and water emulsify into a glossy coating. Season with salt and plenty of black pepper.
To serve: Tear over {{qty:fresh basil=10g}} fresh basil and serve straight from the pan. No cheese.

meals.name: Chickpea & potato coconut stew
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.

Paste: Meanwhile, roughly chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, {{qty:garlic=3}} garlic cloves and {{qty:fresh ginger=10g}} fresh ginger. Blitz or finely chop to a rough paste with {{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=30g}}), {{qty:curry paste=2 tbsp}} curry paste, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes and {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil (add a splash of water if needed).

Stew: Scrape the paste into a large saucepan over medium heat and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until it darkens, smells cooked (not raw), and starts to release oil at the edges (Sodha's cue).

Stew: Stir in {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} salt, {{qty:potatoes=400g}} potatoes cut into 2–3cm chunks, {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a 400g tin}} of chickpeas (drain most of the liquid but keep ~{{x:50 ml=50ml}}), and {{qty:coconut milk|tin=a 400ml tin}} of coconut milk. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 18–20 minutes until the potatoes are soft enough to crush against the side of the pan.
To serve: Grind over black pepper, squeeze in the juice of {{qty:limes=1}} {{pl:limes|lime|limes=lime}}, fluff the rice, and ladle the stew over.

meals.name: Beef & broccoli fried rice
steps: Rice: If you have no cold cooked rice, rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then spread on a tray to steam off for 10 minutes. You want about {{x:400 g=400g}} cooked rice, cool and dry.

Beef: Heat a wok or large deep frying pan over high heat. Add {{qty:minced beef=250g}} minced beef with no oil and fry for 5–6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned with crisp bits. Season with {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} soy sauce and black pepper, then tip onto a plate.

Egg: Add {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} olive oil to the pan. Pour in {{qty:eggs=2}} beaten eggs and cook like a thin omelette for about 1 minute until just set (slightly under is better). Slide onto a board.

Veg: Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:200 g=200g}}) into small florets, slice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, finely chop {{qty:fresh ginger=20g}} fresh ginger and {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves. Add {{qty:olive oil:1.5=1½ tbsp}} olive oil to the pan over medium heat; sizzle the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Turn the heat to high, add the onion and broccoli with {{x:2 tbsp=2 tbsp}} water and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until the broccoli is tender-crisp and the water has gone.
Rice: Push the veg aside and tip in the cold rice. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until hot with a few toasty grains. Add {{x:1.5 tbsp=1½ tbsp}} soy sauce and return the beef.
To serve: Roll up the omelette, slice into ribbons and toss through. Scatter over {{qty:spring onions=2}} sliced spring onions (about {{x:25 g=25g}}) and serve straight away.

meals.name: Feta & pepper egg wraps
steps: Veg: Slice {{qty:bell peppers=2}} bell peppers into thin strips. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat and cook the peppers with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes, until soft and just catching at the edges.
Veg: Add {{qty:spinach=100g}} spinach and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} paprika and stir for 1 minute until the spinach has wilted and any water has cooked off.
Eggs: Beat {{qty:eggs=6}} eggs with black pepper. Turn the heat to low, pour the eggs over the veg and stir gently for 2–3 minutes, until softly set in large curds but still slightly glossy.
Feta: Take the pan off the heat, crumble in {{qty:feta=100g}} feta and fold through. The heat of the pan finishes the eggs.
Wraps: Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side, or 10 seconds each in the microwave, until soft and pliable.
To serve: Spoon the filling down the middle of each tortilla, fold up one end, then fold in the sides and roll. Serve 2 each, straight away.

meals.name: Chicken parm-style bake
steps: Sauce: Dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}. Heat {{qty:olive oil:2=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 8–10 minutes until soft. Add {{qty:garlic=2}} crushed garlic cloves and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes; cook 1 minute. Tip in {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes, season with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt and black pepper, and simmer uncovered for 10–12 minutes until thickened. Taste and adjust the seasoning if the tomatoes are sharp.

Chicken: Meanwhile, cut {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs into strips and season with salt and black pepper. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and fry for 5–7 minutes until cooked through with no pink in the middle. Set aside.
Oven: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cook {{qty:penne=180g}} penne in well-salted boiling water for 9–10 minutes until just tender, drain, and toss with a drizzle of olive oil.

Bake: Tip the penne into a medium baking dish. Stir through the chicken and pour over the tomato sauce. Scatter {{qty:cheddar=50g}} grated cheddar and {{qty:parmesan=20g}} grated parmesan on top. Bake for 15–20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
To serve: Rest 2 minutes. Tear over {{qty:fresh basil=10g}} fresh basil and serve.

meals.name: Tandoori-style yoghurt chicken with rice
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water with a pinch of salt: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave covered off the heat.

Chicken: Slash {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} chicken thighs 2–3 times each. Mix the juice of {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} with {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika and {{qty:red onions:0.5=½}} finely chopped red {{pl:red onions:0.5|onion|onions=onion}} in a bowl. Add the thighs, turn to coat, and rest 10 minutes.

Marinade: Stir {{qty:yoghurt=150g}} yoghurt with {{qty:fresh ginger=15g}} grated fresh ginger, {{qty:garlic=3}} crushed garlic cloves, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper. Pour over the chicken and mix well.

Grill: Heat the grill to high. Lift the thighs onto a rack over a foil-lined tray, brush with {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil, and grill for 8–10 minutes per side until lightly charred and cooked through (juices run clear; no pink at the bone if bone-in — ours are boneless chunks/thighs cooked through).
To serve: Fluff the rice, divide between {{n:2|plate|plates=2 plates}} with the chicken, and scatter the remaining chopped red onion.

meals.name: Beef enchiladas
steps: Filling: Finely chop {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}, dice {{qty:bell peppers=1}} {{pl:bell peppers|bell pepper|bell peppers=bell pepper}} and crush {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-low heat and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until soft but not golden. Turn the heat to medium-high, add {{qty:minced beef=300g}} minced beef and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.

Spices: Stir in the garlic for 1 minute, then {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika and {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes for 1 minute more.

Sauce: Add {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} tomato puree ({{qty:tomato puree=15g}}), {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes, {{qty:stock cubes=½}} crumbled {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}}, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt, some black pepper and {{x:100 ml=100ml}} water. Simmer for 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick enough that a spoon leaves a trail. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) while it simmers.
Roll: Divide the beef between {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas, spooning it down the middle of each, then fold the sides in and lay them seam-side down, snugly, in an ovenproof dish.
Bake: Scatter over {{qty:cheddar=50g}} grated cheddar and bake for 15 minutes until the cheese has melted and the tortilla edges are golden. Rest for 2 minutes and serve 2 each.

meals.name: Salmon & Potato Frittata
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Dice {{qty:potatoes=300g}} potatoes into 1cm cubes, dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and chop {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves.

Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a 24cm ovenproof frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the potatoes for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and tender. Add the onion for the last 3 minutes and the garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Cut {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} salmon fillets into 2cm chunks (skin removed) and add with {{qty:spinach=100g}} spinach. Cook for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts; season with salt.

Grate {{qty:parmesan=40g}} parmesan. Beat {{qty:eggs=6}} eggs with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} black pepper, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} paprika and {{qty:parmesan:30|ref=30g}} of the parmesan.
Turn the heat to medium, add {{qty:butter=15g}} butter to the pan and swirl, then pour the eggs evenly over the filling without stirring. Cook for 3 minutes until the sides are just set.
Scatter the remaining parmesan on top and transfer to the oven for 8 minutes until the centre is just set.
Rest for 3 minutes, slide onto a board, cut in half and serve.

meals.name: Garlic Tomato Chicken Thigh Spaghetti
steps: Oven: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Pat {{qty:chicken thighs=4}} boneless chicken thighs dry and season with salt and black pepper. Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large ovenproof frying pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side.

Oven: Add {{qty:butter=20g}} butter, {{qty:garlic=4}} bashed garlic cloves (skins on), {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{qty:tomatoes=5}} tomatoes (halved if large) and {{qty:onions=1}} sliced {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}. Transfer to the oven and roast for 15–18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Pasta: Meanwhile, cook {{qty:spaghetti=180g}} spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, drain.

Sauce: Lift out the chicken to rest. Back on the hob over medium heat, squeeze the garlic from its skins into the pan and mash the tomatoes into a light sauce with a fork. Crumble in {{qty:stock cubes=½}} {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}} and splash in pasta water; stir and season.

To serve: Toss the spaghetti through the sauce with half of {{qty:fresh basil=10g}} fresh basil and half of {{qty:parmesan=30g}} grated parmesan. Slice the chicken and arrange on top. Finish with the remaining basil, the rest of the parmesan and a drizzle of {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil.

meals.name: Salmon & Spinach Rice with Lemon
steps: Rice: Halve and slice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}; finely chop {{qty:fresh ginger=15g}} fresh ginger. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large lidded frying pan over medium heat and fry the onion and ginger for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} cumin and {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} garam masala for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Rice: Add {{qty:garlic=1}} chopped garlic {{pl:garlic|clove|cloves=clove}}, {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes, {{qty:bell peppers=1}} roughly chopped {{pl:bell peppers|bell pepper|bell peppers=bell pepper}} and {{qty:rice=120g}} rinsed rice; stir briefly. Pour in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} boiling water with {{qty:stock cubes=1}} {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}} crumbled in. Cover and simmer on low for 12–15 minutes until the rice is tender and the stock absorbed (uncover for the last minute if it's still wet).

Salmon: Meanwhile, heat the grill to medium and line a tray with foil. Mix {{qty:yoghurt=60g}} yoghurt with half of {{qty:fresh coriander=10g}} chopped fresh coriander, the remaining {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} garam masala and a pinch of salt. Spread over {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} skinless salmon fillets.
Salmon: Grill for 8–10 minutes until the yoghurt is lightly charred and the fish flakes easily in the centre.
Spinach: Stir {{qty:spinach=160g}} chopped spinach into the rice, cover for 3 minutes to wilt, then fold through and season with black pepper.
To serve: Top the rice with the salmon (whole or flaked), scatter the rest of the coriander and serve with {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} cut into wedges.

meals.name: Salmon & Lemon Risotto with Parmesan
steps: Salmon: Crumble {{qty:stock cubes=1}} {{pl:stock cubes|stock cube|stock cubes=stock cube}} into {{x:750 ml=750ml}} boiling water in a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer. Lower in {{qty:salmon fillet=2}} salmon fillets and poach for 6 minutes until just opaque. Lift out, peel off the skin and set aside. Keep the stock hot on a low heat.

Base: Finely dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}}. Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil and half of {{qty:butter=25g}} butter in a wide pan over medium-low heat. Cook the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft but not golden. Add {{qty:garlic=1}} crushed garlic {{pl:garlic|clove|cloves=clove}} for 1 minute, then {{qty:arborio rice=150g}} arborio rice; stir for 2 minutes until every grain is coated and glossy.

Stock: Add a ladle of the hot stock and stir often until absorbed. Keep adding a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18–20 minutes until the rice is creamy and tender with a slight bite. Add a splash of hot water if you run out.
Salmon: With the last ladle, flake in the poached salmon and season with plenty of black pepper. Warm through for 2 minutes.
Finish: Take off the heat. Beat in the remaining butter, the juice of {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} and {{qty:parmesan=30g}} grated parmesan. Taste for salt (the stock is salty).
To serve: Scatter the lemon zest over and serve straight away — it should flow slightly on the plate.

meals.name: Baked Eggs in Tomato & Chickpea Sauce with Spinach
steps: Dice {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and finely chop {{qty:garlic=3}} garlic cloves. Drain and rinse {{qty:chickpeas|tin=a 400g tin}} of chickpeas.

Heat {{qty:olive oil=2 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan with a lid over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} cumin and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} salt for 1 minute.
Add {{qty:chopped tomatoes|tin=a 400g tin}} of chopped tomatoes and the chickpeas. Simmer for 8 minutes, crushing some chickpeas against the pan, until thick.
Stir in {{qty:spinach=150g}} spinach a handful at a time until wilted, about 2 minutes. Taste for salt.
Make {{qty:eggs=4}} dips, crack an egg into each and swirl the whites slightly into the sauce.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan. Rest the pan off the heat for 2 minutes, add black pepper, and serve with the tortillas.

meals.name: Warm halloumi, chickpea & broccoli salad
steps: Prep: Put the kettle on. Thinly slice {{qty:red onions=½}} {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}} into wedges, put it in a bowl, cover with boiling water and leave for 5 minutes, then drain. Cut {{qty:broccoli=½}} broccoli into small florets. Slice {{qty:bell peppers=1}} {{pl:bell peppers|bell pepper|bell peppers=bell pepper}} into strips and cut {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes into wedges.
Dressing: In a large bowl, whisk the zest and juice of {{qty:lemons=1}} {{pl:lemons|lemon|lemons=lemon}} with {{qty:olive oil:2=2 tbsp}} olive oil, the chilli flakes, salt and black pepper.

Broccoli & chickpeas: Cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling water for 3 minutes, until just tender. Add {{qty:chickpeas=400g}} drained chickpeas for the last minute. Drain well, then toss with the dressing while still warm.

Peppers: Heat {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the pepper strips for 4–5 minutes, until soft and charred in patches. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and drained onion and toss.

Halloumi: Cut {{qty:halloumi=225g}} halloumi into {{n:8|slice|slices=8 slices}} and pat dry. Heat the remaining {{qty:olive oil:0.5=½ tbsp}} oil in the same pan over medium-high heat and fry the slices for 1–2 minutes per side, until deep golden.
To serve: Divide the salad between {{n:2|plate|plates=2 plates}} and lay the hot halloumi on top. Eat straight away while the cheese is soft.

meals.name: Beef Meatballs with Yoghurt & Herbs
steps: Koftas: Grate half of {{qty:onions=1}} {{pl:onions|onion|onions=onion}} and thinly slice the other half. Crush {{qty:garlic=2}} garlic cloves and finely chop {{n:1|bunch|bunches=a bunch}} of fresh coriander ({{qty:fresh coriander=30g}}), keeping a small handful of leaves back. Put {{qty:minced beef=400g}} minced beef in a bowl with the grated onion, garlic, chopped coriander, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} paprika, {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes, {{taste:1 tsp=1 tsp}} mixed herbs, {{taste:0.75 tsp=¾ tsp}} salt and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} black pepper. Work it with your hands for 2 minutes until it is a smooth, evenly mixed paste, then roll into about {{n:20|small ball|small balls=20 small balls}}.

Fry: Heat {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the koftas for 3–4 minutes without moving them, turn and fry for another 3–4 minutes, then shake the pan for 1–2 minutes until browned all over and cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Tomato salad: Meanwhile, dice {{qty:tomatoes=2}} tomatoes and toss them with the sliced onion, {{qty:olive oil:1=1 tbsp}} olive oil and a pinch of salt.

Yoghurt & chilli butter: Warm {{qty:yoghurt=200g}} yoghurt with a pinch of salt in a small pan over low heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until just warm. Do not let it bubble or it will split. Melt {{qty:butter=25g}} butter in a second small pan over low heat with {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} chilli flakes and {{taste:0.5 tsp=½ tsp}} mixed herbs for 1 minute until it foams.

To serve: Warm {{qty:tortillas=4}} tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side. Spoon the warm yoghurt onto plates, pile the koftas on top, drizzle with the chilli butter and scatter with the reserved coriander. Serve with the tortillas and the tomato salad.

meals.name: Spiced halloumi, broccoli & spinach rice
steps: Rice: Rinse {{qty:rice=150g}} rice and cook in {{x:300 ml=300ml}} water: boil, cover, simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then rest covered.

Veg: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Cook {{qty:broccoli=¾}} {{pl:broccoli|head|heads=head}} of broccoli (about {{x:250 g=250g}}), cut into florets, for 4 minutes over high heat, adding {{qty:spinach=100g}} spinach for the final 1 minute. Drain well.

Halloumi: Heat {{qty:olive oil=1 tbsp}} olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and fry {{qty:red onions=1}} sliced {{pl:red onions|red onion|red onions=red onion}} for 5 minutes. Turn up the heat, add {{qty:halloumi|tin=a 225g block}} of halloumi cut into cubes (patted dry) and cook for 4–5 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides.

Spice: Add {{qty:garlic=1}} crushed garlic {{pl:garlic|clove|cloves=clove}}, {{qty:fresh ginger=15g}} finely grated fresh ginger and {{qty:curry paste=1 tbsp}} curry paste; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toss: Stir in the rice, broccoli and spinach and toss for 2 minutes until hot, adding {{x:1 tbsp=1 tbsp}} water if it looks dry. Season with black pepper only — the halloumi seasons the rest.
To serve: Divide between {{n:2|bowl|bowls=two bowls}} and scatter {{taste:0.25 tsp=¼ tsp}} chilli flakes over.
